name: 窗户
label: 拱形开窗
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One arched window with two shutters opened outward, broad sill and a simple folded curtain inside, few clear frame divisions.
Draw only this architectural component, no surrounding wall or building. Clean hand-drawn outlines and generous empty white interiors. No brick, woodgrain, hatch marks, glass shine strokes, gray wash, shadow, tiny repeating shutters slats or extra decorative objects. Fully visible, centered with 12 percent clear margins.
